changelog:
- TikTok Live integration changed from periodic live monitoring and notifications to a one-time onboarding tip about following HiNiHao's TikTok account and enabling live notifications.
- Added the `tiktok_tip_shown` field in learner profile; removed `tiktok_live_enabled` and live session notification logic.
- No background polling or session-based alerts; TikTok promotion is now user-actionable and non-intrusive.
- All other functionality remains unchanged.
